title: On a transcode store shared between machines, the time from a worker finishing a segment to a stream replica on another node serving it is unmeasured
notes: JS-166 criterion 8, not taken. A viewer would feel it as wait added to every start and seek, and as a stall when the store lags a worker that keeps real time. Bounded today by two 600 s plays through S3 across nodes at 1.000 with no segment request over 5 s (one cluster). An unkept reading (p50 14 ms, max 57 ms, at most 40 stored segments, another interval) is never cited. Promote on: a segment request over 5 s or a freeze past the first 30 s while the job's encode speed is at or above 1.0 and worker and stream are on different nodes, on any deployment; an operator report of a slower S3 service; or JS-062 starting, where it becomes a criterion (100 segments, output kept).
